task.title: Create a new group for RHEL viewers
task.shortdesc: After modifying the Default access group, which is automatically renamed to Custom default access group, create a new group that provides permissions for RHEL viewers. You can also create additional groups that provide permissions for RHEL operators or RHEL administrators.

ul.li: You removed RHEL related default roles from Default access group.
You are logged in to the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud ConsoleRed Hat Hybrid Cloud Console as a user who has Organization Administrator permission.

You are on the Groups page, Identity & Access Management User Access Groups You cannot log in to the Hybrid Cloud Console with your email address unless your email address is the same as your Red Hat login. For more information, see .
If you are not an Organization Administrator, you must be a member of a group that has the User Access administrator role assigned to it.

step.cmd: Provide a group name and description. For example:

info.pre: Group name: RHEL Viewers Group description: Users who can view all RHEL services and pages, but cannot execute or edit data

step.cmd: Follow the wizard to locate and add the RHEL viewer role to the group.
Add members of your organization to this group who you want to have RHEL viewer permissions.
Review the group details and submit. A success message appears.

postreq.p: Look at the Groups list and confirm that the RHEL Viewer group is now available. You can enter "RHEL" in the Filter by name search to locate a specific group.
